fields.title: Date&time columns
fields.description: The date&time columns whose values are shifted.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Shift mode
fields.description: Select the shift mode to use.

fields.title: Shift value
fields.description:
Select to insert a format string to use as constant shift value. The inserted string can be either in:
  • the ISO-8601 representation (see date-based duration format for details)
  • the short letter representation (e.g. '2y 3M 1d'). In this case, for the the letters y, M, and d respectively indicate years, months, and days.
  • the long word representation (e.g. '2 years 3 months 1 day').

fields.title: Column
fields.description: Select to choose the shift value from a date-based duration column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Column
fields.description: Select to choose the shift value from a numerical column. The shift value will be scaled by the selected granularity.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Granularity
fields.description: The granularity (i.e. days, weeks, etc) of the shift.

fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Depending on this setting, the output columns will either replace the modified columns, or be appended to the table with a suffix.

fields.title: Output column suffix
fields.description: The suffix to append to the column names of the new columns.
